large-neighbourhood orbit repack started from Laaksonen and Ostergard's published 7812 code (group of order 10): remove every orbit within distance r of a random codeword, solve the weighted independent-set problem on the freed orbits, keep if no smaller; 7812 -> 7847 -> 7857 -> 7929 (radius 6 with refills of up to 50000 candidate orbits); 329 further radius-6 moves gave no gain
